rationale: Russian strikes on Kyiv continue the war pattern; Hungary expelling Russian diplomats is a new EU-Russia shift near Poland's region.

top_events.title: At least two people dead after Russian strikes on Kyiv
top_events.label: Russian drone strikes kill two in Kyiv
top_events.summary: Russian forces resumed drone strikes on Ukraine's capital after a brief pause, killing at least two people. The ongoing war continues to affect regional security near Poland's eastern border.

top_events.title: Hungary expels 10 Russian diplomats as relations worsen
top_events.label: Hungary expels ten Russian diplomats
top_events.summary: Hungary's new government drops its pro-Kremlin stance and expels Russian diplomats, marking a significant shift in EU-Russia relations in Poland's neighborhood.

top_events.title: Canada's retaliatory US tariffs take effect as trade dispute grows
top_events.label: Canada enacts retaliatory tariffs on US goods
top_events.summary: Canada's tariffs on $20 billion of US products take effect, escalating the trade war. EU economies including Poland face indirect risk from global trade tensions.

short_summary: AfD wins 44% in German state election

most_significant_event.label: AfD wins 44% in German state election
most_significant_event.summary: Far-right party projected to win Saxony-Anhalt with 44%, far ahead of conservatives at 17%. First far-right state government in Germany since WWII shifts EU political landscape.
